children.name: Offset Into Media Object Length Type
Offset Into Media Object Length Type
Evidence
children.value: Extended Content Description Object descriptor WMFSDKVersion at 0x12C names "Windows Media Format SDK 12.0.26100.1"

findings.message: The Extended Content Description Object descriptor WM/EncodingSettings names "Lavf60.16.100", but the Extended Content Description Object descriptor WMFSDKVersion names "Windows Media Format SDK 12.0.26100.1"; other software may have rewritten the file, and kept one of them.
The frames of Windows Media Audio versions 1 and 2 are not read: the stream is described by what the container states, and its packets are counted.
